verses.text: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.
verses.line: 1:Jehovah how are mine adversaries increased Many are they that rise up against me

verses.text: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. [Selah
verses.line: 2:Many there are that say of my soul There is no help for him in God Selah

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.line: 3:But thou O Jehovah art a shield about me My glory and the lifter up of my head

verses.text: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. [Selah
verses.line: 4:I cry unto Jehovah with my voice And he answereth me out of his holy hill Selah

verses.text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.
verses.line: 5:I laid me down and slept I awaked for Jehovah sustaineth me

verses.text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.
verses.line: 6:I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.line: 7:Arise O Jehovah save me O my God For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked

verses.text: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. [Selah
verses.line: 8:Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah Thy blessing be upon thy people Selah
